verdict.rationale: Activepieces ships a native AI Agent Builder where users describe a task in plain language ('summarise my unread emails every morning') and the assistant drafts a fully configured agent with name, instructions, and tools, then executes it with approval gates — this is a built-in AI assistant, not an external integration. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the agent-builder chat feature (community evidence only covers pricing/setup, not this capability).
